methodology.isolation: Direct Miniflare getD1Database; no Wrangler CLI/getPlatformProxy; no remote bindings, CF lookup, telemetry, registration, R2, assets, fixed ports, or production configuration. Separate benchmark-only D1 IDs under a freshly created local run directory. Marker created and verified before migrations/fixtures and before each mutation phase. Persistence retained, never cleaned automatically.
methodology.corpus: Deterministic mixed Chinese/Latin corpus with 50,000 rows per lane, including one intentionally synthetic, incomplete target word index and 100 separated-character distractors. Only the target standalone 云桥 token is omitted. All other seeded fields use product indexText; original records are identical across lanes. The 101-row cohort changes the corpus versus historical runs. Required 备份 and multi-term queries and paired normal writes remain the real-product benchmark; normal write workload is unchanged.
methodology.queries: Measure frozen real runFtsChannel for required 备份 and multi-term corpus queries, plus a separately labeled synthetic path-selection fixture 云桥. candidateK=50; 5 warmups and 30 measured samples each; alternate order. The synthetic fixture only demonstrates execution of empty direct MATCH followed by indexed unigram candidates and contiguous original-field verification before LIMIT. It does not establish native ICU contextual behavior. D1 duration sums every SQL statement; wall includes host segmentation, proxy IPC and mapping. Raw rows and traces are retained.
methodology.writes: Paired alternating old/new lanes insert the same 20 new memories in one atomic D1 batch each round, after the 50k-row query run. Same row/version/tag/map/trigram/change statements; new lane additionally uses real wordIndexStatements (including Intl.Segmenter indexText and guarded DELETE/INSERT) per row. Corpus generation and SHA-256 occur before timing. Preparation includes binding and real segmentation; batch wall measures await db.batch only; end-to-end is their sum. Existing tag tokens are prepared during setup, not timed. This is a controlled insert workload, not the complete MemoryRepo/API request path. No updates/deletes/backfill throughput claim.
methodology.size: D1 result.meta.size_after reports workerd SQL databaseSize, not billing size. Index payload sums data/docsize/term/content bytes, excluding b-tree cell/header overhead. dbstat is attempted through D1 and read-only persisted SQLite after disposal for exact per-table allocated pages. SQLite page count/size/freelist and disk files/WAL measured only after runtime disposal because D1 denies these PRAGMAs. Natural FTS merges; no optimize or vacuum. Reserved _cf_ metadata tables are excluded from D1 rowcounts.
methodology.load: Single benchmark process, no simultaneous benchmark queries/writes; machine background load is not controlled. Load averages, process CPU/memory and top CPU processes sampled at phase boundaries. Not production latency or an unloaded-machine SLA.
methodology.synthetic_path_selection: Intentionally synthetic path-selection fixture: the standalone 云桥 token is deliberately omitted from one target seed word index while original fields and unigram tokens are retained. That target does NOT have a complete product word index. This is NOT a naturally occurring ICU index and does NOT prove native contextual-boundary behavior.
